content: Add a token-bucket rate limiter to the public REST endpoints in src/server/. 60 req/min per IP, 429 on overflow.

content.text: I'll read the server entry to see how middleware is wired today.
Creating a rate-limit middleware and wiring it into the public router.

content.text: Done. 60 req/min/IP, 429 on overflow. Refill is continuous so steady traffic just under the cap goes through cleanly.
